## 2026.10.18 - Yeast datasets served in KG 4.0

**Table 1.** The 70 *S. cerevisiae* datasets the served knowledge graph carries, grouped by readout. *Experiments* is the dataset's experiment count in the release snapshot. *Gene-level* is yes when the readout is a property of a gene or a named locus (an expression level, a protein abundance, a copy number) and no when it is a property of the whole cell (growth, viability, morphology, a metabolite or product level). *New* marks a dataset absent from the previous release. Release `2026.10.17-4295f7ca` (KG 4.0, torchcell v1.8.3, built 2026-10-17, 143,075,580 nodes over 3 organisms), compared with `2026.10.06-4b293d34` (KG 3.0).
